milestones.title: The AI Act enters into force
milestones.summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 enters into force. Nothing is yet enforceable; the dates below start the clock on each group of rules.

milestones.title: Prohibited practices and AI literacy apply
milestones.summary: Chapters I and II apply: the Article 5 prohibitions and the Article 4 AI literacy duty. Article 4 has since been amended; the consolidated text frames the provider and deployer duty as taking measures that support AI literacy, with no required level for any individual.

milestones.title: General-purpose AI obligations, governance and penalties apply
milestones.summary: Chapter V (general-purpose AI models), Chapter VII (governance), Chapter XII (penalties), notified body rules in Chapter III Section 4 and Article 78 apply, except Article 101.

milestones.title: The Digital Omnibus on AI enters into force
milestones.summary: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amends the AI Act, signed on 8 July 2026. It moves the high-risk dates and adds the new Article 5 prohibitions.

milestones.title: General application date: transparency duties and Commission enforcement over general-purpose AI
milestones.summary: The general application date in Article 113 arrives. Article 50 transparency duties apply, subject to the Article 50(2) transition below. Article 101, the fines for providers of general-purpose AI models, applies from this date because it was excluded from 2 August 2025.

milestones.title: Deadline for Article 50(2) marking on systems already on the market
milestones.summary: Providers of generative systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 must comply with the Article 50(2) duty to mark synthetic output by this date. Systems placed on the market on or after 2 August 2026 get no grace period.

milestones.title: New Article 5 prohibitions apply
milestones.summary: The new prohibitions added by the Omnibus, covering AI systems that generate non-consensual intimate imagery and child sexual abuse material, apply from this date.

milestones.title: General-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply
milestones.summary: Providers of general-purpose AI models that were on the market before 2 August 2025 must take the necessary steps to comply by this date.

milestones.title: High-risk obligations apply to Annex III use cases
milestones.summary: Chapter III Sections 1 to 3 apply to AI systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(2) and Annex III, such as employment, education, credit scoring and essential services. Moved by the Omnibus from 2 August 2026.

milestones.title: High-risk obligations apply to AI in Annex I regulated products
milestones.summary: Chapter III Sections 1 to 3 apply to AI systems classified as high-risk under Article 6(1) and Annex I, such as safety components of regulated products. Moved by the Omnibus from 2 August 2027.

milestones.title: High-risk systems for public authorities already on the market must comply
milestones.summary: High-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities and placed on the market before the high-risk rules apply must be brought into compliance by this date.

milestones.title: AI components of large-scale IT systems must comply
milestones.summary: AI systems that are components of the large-scale IT systems listed in Annex X, placed on the market or put into service before 2 August 2027, must be brought into compliance by this date.
